b: Planning trips meant a spreadsheet for days, an inbox for bookings and a notes app for places, so I built Atlas: https://goatlas.fyi/?ref=reddit
- Describe the trip in one sentence; it plans each day as stops on a line over a pencil map
- Ask it to change a day ("make day 3 slower")
- Drop in tickets/PDFs, budget in any currency, calendar feed, works offline
- Use it from ChatGPT or Claude
It deliberately shows no travel times (they were often wrong); every place opens in Google Maps instead. Free in beta, solo-built.
What would make you switch from Google Docs/Sheets for trip planning?
